chemistry-h3-q2.title: Mu bvunzo ye initial
chemistry-h3-q2.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-h3-q2.material: Mu bvunzo ye initial rates yereaction 2NO(g) + O₂(g) → 2NO₂(g), kana [O₂] yakachengetwa yakagara uye [NO] yakaitwa kaviri, rate yakava ka 4 yakakura, uye kana [NO] yakachengetwa yakagara uye [O₂] yakaitwa kaviri, rate yakava ka 2 yakakura. Rate law neoverall reaction order yereaction iyi ndeipi?
chemistry-h3-q2.s.s1.prompt: Mu bvunzo ye initial rates yereaction 2NO(g) + O₂(g) → 2NO₂(g), kana [O₂] yakachengetwa yakagara uye [NO] yakaitwa kaviri, rate yakava ka 4 yakakura, uye kana [NO] yakachengetwa yakagara uye [O₂] yakaitwa kaviri, rate yakava ka 2 yakakura. Rate law neoverall reaction order yereaction iyi ndeipi?
chemistry-h3-q2.s.s1.explain: Kana $[\text{NO}]$ yakakura ka $2$ rate inova ka $4$, saka $m=2$, uye kana $[\text{O}_2]$ yakakura ka $2$ rate inova ka $2$, saka $n=1$. Rate law ndi $v = k[\text{NO}]^2[\text{O}_2]$, uye overall reaction order ndi $2 + 1 = 3$.

chemistry-h3-c.title: [Colligative properties dzepamusoro dze
chemistry-h3-c.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-h3-c.material: [Colligative properties dzepamusoro dze solutions] Ndeipi sarudzo ine zvirevo zvose zvakarurama chete pamusoro pehunhu (colligative properties) hwe dilute solution ine nonvolatile, nonelectrolyte solute? (i) Zvinoenderana nenhamba chete yema solute particles (molality), pasina hunhu hwerudzi rwe solute. (ii) Vapor pressure inodzikiswa uye boiling point inokwidziridzwa kana tichienzanisa ne pure solvent. (iii) Fomula yaVan 't Hoff ye osmotic pressure, Π = cRT, yakafanana ne ideal gas equation of state.

(iii) Fomula yaVan 't Hoff ye osmotic pressure, Π = cRT, yakafanana ne ideal gas equation of state.
chemistry-h3-c.s.s1.explain: Ma colligative properties e solution anoenderana nenhamba yema particles chete, pasina hunhu hwemakemikari e solute, uye anosanganisira vapor pressure lowering, boiling point elevation, freezing point depression, ne osmotic pressure ($\Pi = cRT$), saka (i), (ii), ne (iii) zvose zvakarurama.

chemistry-killer-12.title: Pa 25 °C $\mathrm{p}K_a
chemistry-killer-12.goal: Apply principles to solve the inquiry problem.
chemistry-killer-12.material: Pa 25 °C $\mathrm{p}K_a = 4.7$ ye acetic acid ($\mathrm{CH_3COOH}$).
